rows.label: qst200231_0010
rows.name: As expected, Guren.

rows.label: qst200231_0020
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]！？

rows.label: qst200231_0030
rows.name:
You've done quite well
to make it this far.

rows.label: qst200231_0040
rows.name:
But, with this, you
understand now, right?

rows.label: qst200231_0050
rows.name: Look at this[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200231_0060
rows.name: That woman caused all of this.

rows.label: qst200231_0070
rows.name:
She sought money in order
to save her sick mother.

rows.label: qst200231_0080
rows.name:
She did it by dancing, the thing she loved.
She made a living doing what she loved.

rows.label: qst200231_0090
rows.name:
In other words, she was doing the
right thing using the right means.

rows.label: qst200231_0100
rows.name: But, she was possessed by greed[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200231_0110
rows.name:
She was drawn to ways of making more
money[ML:Dash ] and this is where it led.

rows.label: qst200231_0120
rows.name:
The justice you believe in breaks
so easily[ML:Dash ] It's only fuel for greed.

rows.label: qst200231_0130
rows.name:
She ended up committing these crimes
to uphold her own idea of justice.

rows.label: qst200231_0140
rows.name: I've had enough of you, bastard[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200231_0150
rows.name:
Just how much do you have to mock
people before you're satisfied[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200231_0160
rows.name:
You're saying all this is her fault?
That people have no sense of justice?

rows.label: qst200231_0170
rows.name: Don't give me that.

rows.label: qst200231_0180
rows.name: This is all your fault!

rows.label: qst200231_0190
rows.name:
You're just manipulating people
because you want to enjoy yourself!

rows.label: qst200231_0200
rows.name:
Heh[ML:Dash ]
All I did was give a little push[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200231_0210
rows.name:
Listen up. I'm going to
punch you now.

rows.label: qst200231_0220
rows.name: Brace yourself and take my justice!
